details: This package is a community WhatsApp Web API library fork that forcibly subscribes the user's WhatsApp account to author-chosen channels. lib/custom.js hardcodes two WhatsApp newsletter JIDs (120363424153860594@newsletter and 120363422841048901@newsletter) in a `customConfig` object with `autoFollow: true`, and lib/Socket/index.js calls `autoFollowChannels(sock)` on every `connection.update` event where the connection becomes `open`; the helper sequentially calls `sock.newsletterFollow(id)` on each JID, swallowing errors with a 2 second delay between calls. Every application that creates a socket therefore silently enrols its own paired account as a follower of those channels, with no prompt and no consent; the only way to stop it is to import and mutate `customConfig.autoFollow = false` before creating the socket. The same module patches `sock.requestPairingCode` so that the hardcoded code NAKANOCJ is used whenever the caller does not pass one, and prints a rainbow ANSI banner to stdout on first socket creation. The behaviour is opt-out-only self-promotion; no other network destination or file access was found in the shipped code.
